notes.title: Blade Strangers FREE Character update + Graphical improvements + Re-balance
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

The Blade Strangers free update has launched!

As a special celebration for the one year anniversary of Blade Strangers, we are happy to bring some fresh new content for you guys. 

The free Blade Strangers update introduces three new playable characters: adventurer Aban Hawkins (the main protagonist from 1001 Spikes), mystery girl Piaa (the most memorable of the “girlfriend” characters designed by Studio Saizensen founder Toshinobu Kondo for the PlayStation® game Doki Doki Poyacchio) and Summer Kawase, an alternate version of Umihara Kawase with different clothes and different moves.

In addition to the new characters, we are also releasing

Three new stages
Three new background music themes 
Three new story modes
Improved graphics
Balance changes

A big thanks to all of you who have supported Blade Strangers in this amazing first year. We look forward to seeing you push these new characters to their absolute limits!
